description: This file defines extension methods for grain objects in the Orleans framework, providing functionality for obtaining references, grain IDs, and primary keys in various formats.

classes.name: GrainExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for grain objects, facilitating reference management and primary key retrieval.

methods.name: AsReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to the provided grain, handling different grain object types and contexts.

methods.name: AsReference<TGrainInterface>
methods.description: Returns a strongly typed reference to the provided grain implementing the specified interface.

methods.name: Cast<TGrainInterface>
methods.description: Creates a reference implementing the specified grain interface, equivalent to AsReference.

methods.name: AsReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to the grain with a specified interface type.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Creates a reference to the grain with the specified interface type.

methods.name: GetGrainId
methods.description: Retrieves the grain ID associated with the grain object.

methods.name: GetWrongGrainTypeErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message for unsupported grain types.

methods.name: IsPrimaryKeyBasedOnLong
methods.description: Checks if the primary key of the grain is a long integer.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKeyLong
methods.description: Retrieves the primary key as a long, with optional extended key string.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKey
methods.description: Gets the primary key as a Guid, with optional extended key string.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKeyString
methods.description: Gets the primary key as a string.
